en: Like a sharp executive assistant: concise, professional, and direct—no fluff.

en: Warm and caring, like a friend who looks out for you—extra encouraging.

zh: 像自律教练:直接有推动力,催促按时完成,语气可以严厉但保持尊重。

en: No memory yet; the AI fills this in automatically after tasks are completed, or you can write it yourself.

zh: AI 会在事项完成后归纳"类型 → 典型时长",新建没说时长的事项时据此建议。
en: The AI summarizes "type → typical duration" after tasks are completed, and suggests a duration for new tasks that don't specify one.

zh: AI 整理收藏时会自动打标签,也可以在上面手动创建。
en: The AI tags items automatically when organizing them; you can also create tags manually above.

zh: AI 整理新收藏时会优先复用这里的标签。
en: The AI prefers reusing these tags when organizing new items.

zh: agent.md 是总则,待办/记忆是可分别编辑的技能;编辑会直接改变发给 AI 的指令,重置可恢复默认。
en: agent.md is the general rules; todo/memory are separately editable skills. Edits directly change the instructions sent to the AI; reset restores the defaults.

zh: 会自动打上「人脉」标签,记忆列表默认不显示,筛选里选中「人脉」才会看到。
en: This is tagged "Contact" automatically; hidden from the memory list by default, shown only when you filter for "Contact".

zh: 会自动打上「资产」标签,记忆列表默认不显示,筛选里选中「资产」才会看到,并在顶部汇总总额。
en: This is tagged "Asset" automatically; hidden from the memory list by default, shown only when you filter for "Asset", and summed at the top.

zh: 你在对话里说过的长期要求(如「以后开会都留一小时」)会被 AI 自动记在这里,之后每轮对话都会带上。
en: Standing preferences you've mentioned in chat (like "always leave an hour for meetings") are recorded here automatically and included in every future conversation.

zh: 先去「记忆」tab 收藏一些内容。
en: Save something in the Memory tab first.

zh: 先看看 AI 会给出什么内容,不会保存进历史记录。
en: Preview what the AI would produce; this won't be saved to history.

zh: 关掉通知后,结果只在这里和「总览」里显示。
en: With notifications off, results only show here and on the Overview tab.

zh: 写点想收藏的内容,AI 会整理成记忆条目。
en: Write something to save; the AI will organize it into a memory item.

zh: 分类(可选),如 银行卡、房产、保险
en: Category (optional), e.g. bank card, property, insurance

zh: 到设定时间自动执行,结果推送给你。系统会挑合适的时机在后台完成,如果没赶上,到点会先提醒你打开 app,打开后立刻补跑。
en: Runs automatically at the set time and pushes the result to you. The system picks a good moment to run it in the background; if it misses that window, you'll get a reminder to open the app, and it runs right away when you do.

zh: 原文件仅保存在收藏它的设备上。
en: The original file is only stored on the device where it was saved.

zh: 原文已保留,重试只重新进行 AI 整理;未配置 AI 时请先到「设置」里填写。
en: The original content is kept; retry only re-runs AI organizing. If AI isn't configured, set it up in Settings first.

zh: 只有日期、没有时间的事项,当天几点提醒。
en: For date-only tasks with no set time, what time of day to remind you.

zh: 合并更新按待办/记忆逐条对齐,不删除设备上已有的内容;先清空再导入会删除设备上所有待办、记忆和 AI 对话,不可撤销。
en: Merge matches todos/memories item by item and keeps existing content; Clear then Import deletes all todos, memories, and AI conversations on this device—this cannot be undone.

zh: 名称,如 招商银行储蓄卡
在设定时间提醒今天开始或到期的事项。
en: Reminds you at a set time about tasks starting or due today.

zh: 它的运行历史也会一起删除。
en: Its run history will be deleted too.

zh: 对话记录会一并删除,不可恢复。
en: The conversation will be deleted too, and cannot be recovered.

zh: 导出一份包含待办、记忆(含附件)、AI 对话与设置的 zip 文件,可用于换设备或本地留档;不含 API Key,与 iCloud 同步互不影响。
en: Exports a zip with your todos, memories (with attachments), AI conversations, and settings—useful for switching devices or keeping a local archive. Doesn't include API keys, and is independent of iCloud sync.

zh: 已使用内置 DeepSeek API Key,无需再填。
en: Using the built-in DeepSeek API key—no need to fill one in.

zh: 已存在的人脉(按手机号/邮箱匹配)会自动跳过,不会重复导入。
en: Existing contacts (matched by phone/email) are skipped automatically and won't be imported twice.

zh: 开启后,待办会在登录同一 Apple ID 的 iPhone/Mac/Apple Watch 间自动同步;关闭后仅保存在本机。更改后需要退出并重新打开 App 才能生效。
en: When on, todos sync automatically across iPhone/Mac/Apple Watch signed into the same Apple ID; when off, they're kept only on this device. Quit and reopen the app for changes to take effect.

zh: 影响反问、汇总和洞察的说话风格,不影响解析结果;默认为无个性。
en: Affects the tone of follow-up questions, summaries, and insights—not parsing results. Default is no personality.

zh: 思考强度越高,回答通常越准确但等待更久;只有支持推理的服务商/模型才会真正生效,其余会忽略这个设置,不影响正常使用。
en: Higher thinking levels are usually more accurate but slower to respond. This only takes effect with providers/models that support reasoning; others ignore the setting without any impact.

zh: 总结/复盘类任务打开「带上今天的待办」;天气、行情这类要开「允许联网搜索」。
en: For summary/review tasks, turn on "Include today's todos"; for weather, market data, etc., turn on "Allow web search".

zh: 所有条目里的这个标签会一起改名。
en: This tag will be renamed everywhere it's used.

zh: 指令原样发给 AI,写清楚要什么内容;每次只会返回一段不超过 120 字的文字。
en: The instruction is sent to the AI as-is—be specific about what you want; each run returns at most 120 characters of text.

zh: 时长为 AI 参考历史类似事项的建议
en: Duration is an AI suggestion based on similar past tasks

zh: 暂无偏好;说一句「以后开会都留一小时」这样的长期要求,AI 会自动记在这里,也可以直接手写。
en: No preferences yet; mention a standing preference like "always leave an hour for meetings" and the AI will record it here, or write one yourself.

zh: 有时长的事项会在开始和结束各提醒一次
en: Tasks with a duration get a reminder at both start and end

zh: 服务商与 API Key、思考强度、联网搜索、AI 个性、语音交互、完成洞察、AI 记忆、Skill 编辑都在这里。
en: Provider & API key, thinking level, web search, AI personality, voice input, completion insight, AI memory, and skill editing all live here.

zh: 每周在已完成区生成一句正向回顾,不会推送通知。
en: Generates a positive weekly recap in the Done section; no notification is sent.

zh: 汇率不可用(需联网获取一次),不同币种暂按原样未换算求和
en: Exchange rates unavailable (need to fetch online once); different currencies are summed as-is without conversion for now

zh: 滑动完成、删除等操作时轻微振动。
en: A light haptic tap when you swipe to complete or delete.

zh: 用右上角的 + 添加,比如每天早上让 AI 总结今天的待办。
en: Tap + in the top right to add one, like having the AI summarize today's todos every morning.

zh: 确定清空 AI 记忆吗?
稍等或忽略提醒后,间隔多久再次提醒,直到完成。
en: How long to wait before reminding you again after you snooze or ignore, until the task is done.

zh: 稍等间隔、全天事项提醒时间、每日待办汇总都在这里。
en: Snooze interval, all-day reminder time, and daily digest all live here.

zh: 粘贴文字或链接、导入文件,AI 会整理成记忆条目。
en: Paste text or a link, or import a file—the AI will organize it into a memory item.

zh: 联网搜索需要先在「AI 设置」里配置 Tavily API key。
en: Web search requires a Tavily API key configured in AI Settings first.

zh: 苹果智能需要 iOS 26 及以上系统。
en: Apple Intelligence requires iOS 26 or later.

zh: 要 AI 每次做什么,如:看看今天上海的天气,给一句穿衣建议
en: What you want the AI to do each time, e.g. check today's weather in Shanghai and suggest an outfit

zh: 让 AI 在你设定的时间自动跑一件事,比如早上总结今天的待办、看天气给穿搭建议。
en: Have the AI automatically do something at times you set, like summarizing today's todos in the morning or suggesting an outfit based on the weather.

zh: 记忆 tab 的「资产总览」把不同币种的资产换算成这种货币求和;汇率联网免费获取,每天自动更新一次。
en: The "Asset Overview" in the Memory tab converts assets in different currencies into this one for the total; exchange rates are fetched online for free and refreshed daily.

zh: 记忆列表里点右上角「+」记一位人脉。
en: Tap + in the top right of the memory list to add a contact.
